newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS reaffirms BC Tel, outlook stable.
newsitem.headline: CBRS reaffirms BC Tel, outlook stable.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Friday that it reaffirmed the ratings on BC Tel's outstanding securities.
The company's commercial paper remained at A-1+, its first mortgage bonds at A+(High), its debentures and medium-term note debentures at A+(Low) and its preferred shares at P-1, the agency said.
The rating outlook for the company was stable, CBRS said.

BC Tel's good quality ratings ranked among the highest in the industry and were supported by its strong franchise area, modern network, improving operating efficiencies, strong market position and sound financial performance, CBRS said.
Despite some volatility in the company's financial results in recent years, its financial performance measurements continued to compare favorably with other Canadian telcos, the agency said.
